solverModel.normalSkills: all ordinary skills with a non-weapon-side source; normal targets can also be satisfied by weapon-side sources when present
solverModel.weaponSkills: weapon-only skills selected after weapon type; direct weapon skills and weapon decorations are considered
solverModel.artian: base weapon data is available from /weapons; Gogma Artian random skill/reinforcement rolls are not modeled as guaranteed data

notes: Live API-backed database. Randomized charms are excluded from deterministic solver candidates. Series/group targets are solved from armor-set metadata and required piece counts. Skill target pickers are source-aware and audit orphaned skill definitions at load.
